title: Bloons TD Battles
meta_description: The realtime player-vs-player tower defense game of Monkeys vs. Bloons!
full_description: Play the top-rated tower defense franchise in this free head-to-head strategy game.It's monkey vs monkey for the first time ever - go head to head with other players in a Bloon-popping battle for victory. From the creators of best-selling Bloons TD 5, this all new Battles game is specially designed for multiplayer combat, featuring over 50 custom head-to-head tracks, incredible towers and upgrades, all-new range of powers, and the ability to control bloons directly and send them charging past your opponent's defenses.Check out these awesome features:* Head-to-head two player Bloons TD * Over 50 custom Battles tracks * 22 awesome monkey towers, each with 8 powerful upgrades, including the never before seen C.O.B.R.A. Tower.* Assault Mode - manage strong defenses and send bloons directly against your opponent * Defense Mode - build up your income and outlast your challenger with your superior defenses * Battle Arenas - Put your medallions on the line in a high stakes Assault game. Winner takes all.* Card Battles - Build the ultimate deck to slam your opponents in this unique twist on bloons TD gameplay.* All new Powers - supercharge your towers, boost your bloons, or try the new sabotage, eco, and track powers.* Battle it out for top scores on the weekly leaderboards and win awesome prizes.* Create and join private matches to challenge any of your friends * Build your clan and work together to be the best of the best for weekly rewards.* Customize your bloons with decals, or grab new tower skins so your victory has a signature stamp* 16 cool achievements to claim REQUIRES INTERNET CONNECTIONYouTubers and Streamers: Ninja Kiwi is actively developing, supporting, and promoting channel creators on YouTube, Twitch, Kamcord, and Mobcrush. If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and then tell us about your channel at youtube@ninjakiwi.com.
